method: Read-only HTML parser and CSS static checks. Actual app pointer events validated separately by input-review.cjs; actual Three geometry and camera with fake renderer by scene-review.cjs. No browser or phone rendering tested by this agent.

checks.name: All game UI and canvas are inside one transformed shell
Start and pause offer both directions
Shell transform origin is top left
Responsive breakpoints use logical orientation classes
Normal portrait platform top offset wins equal-specificity cascade
Portrait tactical map respects mapped right safe edge
Clockwise and counterclockwise map platform top to left and right

safeAreaFindings: Both identified issues are fixed: normal portrait HUD top padding cascade and portrait tactical map right safe inset.
